audit.why: Taliyah controls pre-6 with Q range; Aurora takes over at 6 (Between Worlds all-in) and keeps the mobility edge with items. Content and packet agree; 51.4% over 463 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated name 'Across the Sand' in spikes[1].text (real: Across the Veil, and it is her W, not E); 'passive true damage plus R healing' in spikes[2] and whys[5] — her passive heals, nothing in the kit is true damage or R healing. No cooldown digits (W 22s, E 15s, R 140s). Spirit Abjuration anti-heal (flagged missing) absent.
audit.why: Kit: P exorcised spirits heal her; W Across the Veil 22/21/20/19/18 leap+invisibility; E The Weirding hops her backward; R 140/120/100. Her hops are dashes — Taliyah E stuns them, Q/W grounding-class tools punish them.
audit.corrected: Names and mechanics corrected; numbers and Oblivion Orb timing folded in.
